rows.headline: Systematix Institutional Equities issues fresh FY27 price targets and outlook for major Indian banks
rows.hook: NIM recovery could lift banking sector profits
rows.summary: Systematix Institutional Equities has released a fresh outlook and price targets for top Indian banking stocks, expecting profitability to improve as net interest margins (NIMs) recover through FY27. rows.headline: How to verify gold jewellery purity using the BIS Care app
rows.hook: Six digits protect your festive gold purchase
rows.summary: The Bureau of Indian Standards provides a six-digit Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID) number on gold jewellery to verify its purity. Retail buyers can use the official BIS Care mobile application to check the authenticity of their items in minutes. Ensuring this verification protects consumers from buying sub-standard gold during festive periods like Dhanteras. Retail investors and consumers holding gold jewellery should verify these markings to ensure asset quality.
rows.why_it_matters: Verify your gold's HUID to ensure proper resale value.

rows.headline: Affirm shares drop as GMV outlook misses expectations
rows.hook: Growth guidance disappoints despite earnings beat
rows.summary: Affirm reported quarterly results that exceeded analyst expectations, driven by strong transaction volume. However, the company's forward-looking guidance for Gross Merchandise Volume (GMV) failed to meet market projections. This discrepancy between current performance and future growth expectations triggered a sell-off in the stock. Indian retail investors tracking global fintech trends should note the market's sensitivity to growth deceleration in the buy-now-pay-later sector.
rows.why_it_matters: Signals cooling growth expectations for global buy-now-pay-later fintech firms.
